_README: TOPICAL TEMPLATE — Stage 2 scoped fact-build for 3 domains ABSENT from the standard facts-template.json (health/pharmacy/hospital billing, Balearic ferries, public holidays/closures). Same contract as the standard template: do NOT change field NAMES or STRUCTURE, fill VALUES only, keep every key (null if you can't fill it). Frame everything for the audience in _meta. STATUS MODEL: 'verified' = confirmed against an OFFICIAL source (URL in source_url); 'agreed_stable' = confident, no source opened; 'verify_recommended' = change-prone or high-stakes, flag it; 'serve_live' = volatile, must NOT be frozen (prices, exchange-driven costs). Return ONLY valid JSON in EXACTLY this structure. Fill EVERY section.

_meta.ai_source: FILL: claude | chatgpt | gemini | grok | deepseek

_fact_field_shape: Every FACT uses: { value, source_url, status (verified|agreed_stable|verify_recommended|serve_live), notes }. For 'verified' the source_url MUST be the official page you checked. Never invent a source.

health_care._note: Covers: Bringing Medication into Spain / Getting Treated in Barcelona: Pharmacy, Clinic or ER / What to Expect When a Spanish Hospital Bills You. YMYL — be conservative, prefer verify_recommended over agreed_stable.

prescription_medication_rules.notes: quantity limits (e.g. ~personal supply for trip length), need for original packaging / doctor's letter or prescription copy

controlled_substances_note.notes: narcotics/psychotropics — Schengen certificate requirement for travelers carrying controlled meds across borders

farmacia_de_guardia.notes: 24h rotating duty-pharmacy system — how a tourist finds the open one

otc_vs_prescription_differences.notes: things OTC in Spain but Rx-only in the US or vice versa

pharmacist_role.notes: Spanish pharmacists routinely advise/treat minor ailments directly

private_clinic_access.notes: walk-in private clinics for tourists — typical cost range

public_hospital_er_access.notes: urgencias access for non-residents, triage-based, whether insurance card is asked for AT the door

when_to_choose_which.notes: RECOMMENDATION — minor issue vs true emergency (112) decision guide

billing_model_public.notes: does a public hospital bill a non-EU tourist directly, and when — at discharge or by mail

typical_costs.notes: rough ranges only: ER visit, ambulance ride, one overnight stay — never frozen as durable prices

travel_insurance_necessity.notes: RECOMMENDATION — is it a hard requirement in practice for this audience

what_to_keep_for_reimbursement.notes: itemized invoice / informe médico / payment receipts for a US insurer claim

ferries_balearics._note: Covers: Ferries from Barcelona to the Balearics: Fast vs Slow / When a Balearic Ferry Cancels, and What You're Owed.

operators.notes: e.g. Trasmediterránea, Baleària — who actually runs Barcelona-Balearics

port_terminal.notes: which Port de Barcelona terminal, how to get there from the center

to_palma_mallorca.notes: fast vs slow ferry duration + rough price range

to_menorca.notes: note if it's direct or routed via Mallorca/Valencia, and seasonality

fast_vs_slow_tradeoffs.notes: RECOMMENDATION — price/time/overnight-cabin tradeoff, who should pick which

booking_advice.notes: how far ahead in summer, walk-on vs car ferry, aggregator vs operator site

passenger_rights.notes: EU ferry passenger rights regulation — compensation, rerouting, care obligations

travel_insurance_interaction.notes: does standard travel insurance cover a missed connection from a cancelled ferry

public_holidays_closures._note: Covers: What Closes on a Spanish Public Holiday (and feeds the existing barcelona-august-shutdown article as a targeted addition). Dates are change-prone per year — flag accordingly.

barcelona_local_holidays.notes: [{name, typical_date}] — city-specific (e.g. La Mercè, Santa Eulàlia)

what_typically_closes.notes: shops (small vs chain), restaurants, banks, museums, transit schedule ('horario festivo')

august_shutdown_specifics.notes: how widespread, typical closure window, what stays open (malls, tourist-facing restaurants, museums) — feeds barcelona-august-shutdown

advance_planning_note.notes: RECOMMENDATION — booking restaurants/checking attraction hours around these dates

_open_questions._note: Anything genuinely unsure / conflicting / needing a real source. Be honest.
